name: Cannon School
design_intent:
PHYSICS-LAB circuit 4, course 1 of 4 (owner 2026-07-16: 'cannons you can ride in'). TEACHES: the rideable cannon, pure — two FIXED barrels (angle_min == angle_max, no timing read) chain the player across a void far too wide to fly. Fly into the barrel, it holds you hold_s and fires you along its aim at 2600 px/s. The course is the ballistics demo: watch the arc once, trust it forever.

BALLISTIC DERIVATION (gravity 1600, impulse 2600, muzzle offset = barrel_len 190 + 40 = 230 along the barrel):
CANNON 1 pivot (640,540), fixed -60 deg. Muzzle = pivot + 230*(cos-60,sin-60) = (755, 341). Launch v = (2600*cos60, -2600*sin60) = (1300, -2252). Apex = 2252^2/(2*1600) = 1585px above the muzzle -> apex y = -1244 (bounds top -1700 clears it with ~450px headroom). Landing on the catch basin top y=1000 (659px below the muzzle): solve 800t^2 - 2252t - 659 = 0 -> t = 3.08s, x = 755 + 1300*3.08 = 4762. The basin spans x4300-5700 (w1400, MARSHMALLOW — the deadest tier so the landing skip is smallest) -> touchdown lands ~460px in from the left edge, ~940px of run-out to the right. Landing velocity is (1300, 2680): the intent teaches the boost-tap brake (boost_enter_keep 0.25 cuts momentum to ~25% on boost start), and a bumper backstop wall (x5700, top y660) catches an un-braked skip and rebounds it back onto the basin (restitution 0.86) instead of losing the run.
CANNON 2 pivot (5500,700), fixed -45 deg, mounted 300px above the basin (marshmallow apex 120 << 300 -> BOOST required to load it; the backstop top y660 is 160px below the fire line so the departing shot clears it by ~110px). Muzzle = (5663, 537). Launch v = (1839, -1839). Apex = 1839^2/3200 = 1056px above -> apex y = -519. Landing on the goal plateau top y=900 (363px below): 800t^2 - 1839t - 363 = 0 -> t = 2.48s, x = 5663 + 1839*2.48 = 10224 — dead-center of the plateau (x9700-10800, w1100). The goal_gate (center 10250,800, w300 h400 -> x10100-10400, y600-1000) sits ON the computed arc: at x=10100 the arc height is y=761, inside the gate, so the ring latches on the fly-through before touchdown.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (flight required):
- Start pad top y1000 -> cannon 1 capture circle (r70 @ 640,540): 460px climb > trampoline apex 270 -> NORMAL BOOST required to load the first cannon.
- Start side -> catch basin: ~3100px of open void (start pad ends x420, basin starts x4300). Boost tank at 760px/s x 3.5s = ~2660px < 3100 -> NOT crossable by flying; the CANNON is the only verb. A bounce is hopeless (spring drift reach ~527px).
- Basin top y1000 -> cannon 2 capture (r70 @ 5500,700): 300px climb off a marshmallow (apex 120) -> BOOST required.
- Basin -> goal plateau: ~4000px void (basin ends 5700, plateau starts 9700) > tank range -> cannon 2 only.
No leg of the course is bounce-reachable; two legs are not even boost-reachable. Flight loads the cannons; cannons do the crossing.

FUEL BUDGET: spawn 100. Load cannon 1 ~0.8s of boost (~23 fuel). Cannon flight costs nothing. Basin: one brake tap + a ~1.2s climb to cannon 2 (~35 fuel), marshmallow touches refund +20 each. Worst case arrives at cannon 2 with ~60+ fuel; the course never runs the tank dry. A short/long landing falls into the void = free respawn at the start_gate.

FAIRNESS: fixed barrels = zero timing skill this course (that is p4_swing_shot's job); landing zones are 1400px and 1100px pads, never a cannon-mouth pixel landing; the goal gate sits on the derived arc. Bounds top -1700 clears the -1244 apex with margin; explicit bounds because the derived side-cap would strangle an 11,000px course.
hint: FLY INTO THE CANNON — IT DOES THE REST
